description: Stable diagnostics raised by the OpenDRIVE reader and decoder. Codes are <PREFIX>-<E|W><NNN>, never renumbered or reused; messages may be reworded. Every message starts with its bracketed code, e.g. "[ODR-E001] ...". Format-independent conditions use the RN- catalog shipped beside this file as rn-diagnostics.json. See docs/reference/DIAGNOSTICS.md.

diagnostics.summary: The source asset could not be opened or read.
diagnostics.action: Check that the path resolves to a readable file, not a directory, and that the resolver can open it.

diagnostics.summary: The document is not well-formed XML: a parse error, no element, more than one top-level element, or text outside the root element.
diagnostics.action: Fix the XML at the reported line and column; a non-validating XML checker reports the same position.

diagnostics.summary: The document is not UTF-8: it has a UTF-16 or UTF-32 byte-order mark or content, or its XML declaration names another encoding.
diagnostics.action: Re-encode the file as UTF-8 and declare encoding="UTF-8" or omit the encoding.

diagnostics.summary: The root element is not <OpenDRIVE> in no namespace.
diagnostics.action: Check that the file is ASAM OpenDRIVE; remove a namespace prefix or a default xmlns from the root element, which OpenDRIVE does not define.

diagnostics.summary: The first child element of <OpenDRIVE> is not <header>.
diagnostics.action: Add the mandatory <header> as the first child of <OpenDRIVE>.

diagnostics.summary: <header> has no revMajor or revMinor attribute, or one is not a non-negative decimal integer.
diagnostics.action: State the specification version as integers, for example revMajor="1" revMinor="8".

diagnostics.summary: The OpenDRIVE version is outside the supported range, revMajor 1 with revMinor 4 to 9.
diagnostics.action: Convert the file to a supported OpenDRIVE version; versions before 1.4 and after 1.9 are rejected rather than guessed.

diagnostics.summary: A required element or attribute is missing, such as a road's length or junction, a geometry's <line> or <arc>, a lane's type, or a non-center lane's <width>.
diagnostics.action: Add the element or attribute the message names; OpenDRIVE requires it.

diagnostics.summary: An attribute value is not valid for its type: not an xsd:double or a 32-bit integer, or not one of the values OpenDRIVE 1.4 to 1.9 defines for it, such as a lane type or a contactPoint.
diagnostics.action: Write the value the message names in the form the OpenDRIVE schema gives, with a decimal point rather than a comma.

diagnostics.summary: An element appears more often than OpenDRIVE allows where it is, or where it is not allowed: for example two <planView> elements, two shapes in one <geometry>, or a <width> on the center lane.
diagnostics.action: Remove the repeated or misplaced element.

diagnostics.summary: A lane's id does not match its group: lanes in <left> are positive, the lane in <center> is 0, and lanes in <right> are negative.
diagnostics.action: Move the lane to the group its id belongs to, or renumber it.

diagnostics.summary: A lane predecessor or successor at a road's start or end has no road predecessor or successor to follow.
diagnostics.action: Add the road link at that end, or remove the lane link.

diagnostics.summary: A lane predecessor or successor at a road's end leads into a junction, where it does not say which connecting road it means.
diagnostics.action: Remove the lane link and state it with the junction's <connection>/<laneLink> elements, as OpenDRIVE specifies.

diagnostics.summary: For a junction connection, the end of the incoming road that meets the junction cannot be determined: the connecting road does not link back to the incoming road, and the incoming road does not link to the junction at exactly one end.
diagnostics.action: Link the connecting road's contact end to the incoming road, or link the incoming road to the junction.

diagnostics.summary: A plan-view geometry is a <poly3>, which is deprecated since OpenDRIVE 1.6.0 and not supported.
diagnostics.action: Convert the geometry to a <paramPoly3>, a <spiral>, or lines and arcs.

diagnostics.summary: A <superelevation>, <crossfall>, or <shape> record has a non-zero coefficient, or the road has a <crossSectionSurface>; Phase 1 cannot place the borders out of the road plane.
diagnostics.action: Remove the lateral profile or set its coefficients to zero, or wait for Phase 2 support (F-13).

diagnostics.summary: A lane is defined by a <border>, which Phase 1 does not support.
diagnostics.action: Describe the lane with <width> records, or wait for Phase 2 support (F-13).

diagnostics.summary: A junction is direct, virtual, or crossing, or a road link uses elementS or elementDir; Phase 1 supports default junctions only.
diagnostics.action: Model the junction as a default junction with connecting roads.

diagnostics.summary: A road has a temporary lane layer (<lanes layer="temporary">) or a lane link to one; Phase 1 reads the permanent layer only.
diagnostics.action: Remove the temporary layer, or wait for lane-layer support.

diagnostics.summary: The plan view, a profile, or the lane structure holds an element this decoder does not know; it could change the geometry or the lanes, so it is not ignored.
diagnostics.action: Check the element name against the OpenDRIVE version the header states; remove or correct it.

diagnostics.summary: The source asset is larger than the 512 MiB import limit, so none of it is read.
diagnostics.action: Split the network into smaller files, or check that the path names an OpenDRIVE file and not other data.

diagnostics.summary: An internal failure, such as running out of memory, stopped the read.
diagnostics.action: Report it with the input file if it is not a resource limit; it indicates a bug.

diagnostics.summary: Road marks (<roadMark>) are not authored in Phase 1.
diagnostics.action: None needed unless road marks are required; they are planned with the cross-section extensions (F-13).

diagnostics.summary: Signals, signal references, and controllers are not authored in Phase 1.
diagnostics.action: None needed unless traffic semantics are required; they are planned for Phase 2 (F-14).

diagnostics.summary: Road objects, object references, tunnels, and bridges are not authored in Phase 1.
diagnostics.action: None needed unless road objects are required; they are planned for Phase 2 (F-15).

diagnostics.summary: User data, <include>, and <dataQuality> elements are not authored.
diagnostics.action: None needed; vendor extensions are not part of the stage contract (ADR 0002 section 4).

diagnostics.summary: A road speed whose maximum is "no limit" or "undefined" is not authored.
diagnostics.action: None needed; the road keeps its numeric speed records.

diagnostics.summary: Elements outside the Phase 1 scope, such as lane speeds, lane access and material, road surfaces, junction priorities, and stations, are read but not authored; the message lists them.
diagnostics.action: None needed unless those elements are required; the capability matrix lists what is supported.

diagnostics.summary: Attributes that the model does not represent, such as a road's rule or a road type's type and country, are not authored; the message lists them.
diagnostics.action: None needed unless those attributes are required.

diagnostics.summary: Elements unknown to this decoder, outside the plan view, the profiles, and the lane structure, are ignored; the message lists them.
diagnostics.action: Check the element names against the OpenDRIVE version the header states.
